summary: Master water and wastewater utility management with KPI dashboards, maintenance prioritization, and emergency planning. Enrol today.
lede: Utility management training gives water and wastewater supervisors and operations staff practical ways to organize service, staffing and asset oversight. Participants work on performance indicators and data checks, prioritize maintenance and workforce tasks, and develop process oversight, emergency response and management reporting tools that connect operational records and field conditions with clear actions for utility leadership.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who manage, supervise, support, or report on water and wastewater utility operations. It fits practitioners who need practical management tools, clearer performance reporting, and stronger control over assets, staffing, and incident response.
prerequisites: Participants should bring a laptop for spreadsheet-based exercises and be prepared to work with sample utility reports, KPI tables, and maintenance logs. Access to basic spreadsheet software is recommended, and no specialised programming environment is required.
topics: Water & wastewater treatment and utility management
